description: Native Markdown editor built with Go and MyGo Native UI, featuring Arc-style Spaces, rich text editing, and standard Markdown files
notes: ArcMD stores its settings in '%APPDATA%\ArcMD' (spaces.json, prefs.json, plugins, trash) unless ARCMD_HOME is set, which this manifest points at the Scoop persist directory.
New spaces are created as regular folders under '%USERPROFILE%\Documents\ArcMD' by default; those are your own documents and are not managed by Scoop.
